purpose: Future exact-candidate evidence digest index. Every acceptance-critical evidence URI referenced by the candidate packet or critic records must appear exactly once here with a verified SHA-256.

entry_contract.uri_rule: unique non-empty evidence reference exactly matching a reference used by the candidate/critic records
entry_contract.sha256_rule: exact lowercase 64-hex digest of the referenced evidence bytes
entry_contract.candidate_source_rule: exact same 40-hex T12 candidate SHA for every candidate-specific item
entry_contract.content_verified_rule: must be true before final candidate disposition

acceptance_rules: Every entry category must be allowed.
Every final entry has exact SHA-256, exact candidate source, non-empty producer and content_verified=true.
Every evidence reference required by the resolved candidate packet and resolved critic records appears exactly once.
Unknown extra evidence may be indexed, but it cannot replace any required reference.
The evidence index cannot make a failed report, critic dimension, gate or defect pass; it only proves completeness and byte identity.
